# Send a player back to Hero Select

Source: [wiki article 4856](../archive/4856.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4856-n1"></a>

- To return a player to hero select, remove their current hero from Allowed Heroes then reset hero availability; useful where no spawn room permits changing hero.

<a id="wiki-4856-n2"></a>

- Example triggers this on Interact using Ongoing Each Player.
